decision: Reprimand - Driving (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
event_name: Date 29 November 2019 Time 19:33 2019 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 28 November - 1 December 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 9 & 10) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Incident between car 77 and car 8 in turn 11.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand - Driving (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and heard from the driver of car 77 (Valtteri Bottas), the driver of car 8 (Romain Grosjean) and the team representatives. Valtteri accepted responsibility for the collision and acknowledged that it was a failed attempt at an overtake which resulted in the collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 77 Incident With Car 8 In Turn 11
